transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Lately, I've been feeling extremely overwhelmed by these persistent, intrusive worries that I just can't seem to shake. It has gotten to the point where I feel this uncontrollable urge to repeat certain actions, like checking or cleaning, over and over again just to feel safe.

Do these thoughts feel like unwanted, intrusive ideas that push you to do rituals like checking or cleaning, or are they more like ongoing worries about many everyday things such as work, health, or family?

Yes, they are definitely unwanted, intrusive thoughts that force me into rituals, rather than normal everyday worries. I get these intense fears about germs and contamination that make me wash my hands repeatedly, or constant doubts about whether the doors are locked that force me to check them over and over.
How much time do these thoughts and rituals take each day, and do they interfere with your work, school, or relationships?

I'm not quite sure how many hours it takes or how to measure the exact impact on my life. It's hard to put a number on it, but it definitely feels like it takes up a huge amount of my energy every day.
Do you recognize that these fears and rituals are excessive or unreasonable, even though they still feel hard to resist?
I'm not really sure, and I haven't really thought about it that way. In the moment, they just feel like things I absolutely have to do.
How long have you been having these intrusive thoughts and repeating these behaviors?
I'm not entirely sure how long it has been going on, as I haven't kept track of the exact timeline. It feels like it has been happening for quite a while, but I can't pinpoint when it first started.
If you try not to do the checking or cleaning, what happens—do you become very anxious or feel like something bad will happen?

Yes, if I try to stop myself, the anxiety and dread become absolutely overwhelming. I get this intense fear that something terrible will happen, like a break-in, a fire, or that I'll get dangerously contaminated. The only way to make that unbearable tension go away is to just give in and do the ritual.
Did these symptoms start after using any drugs, starting a new medication, or having a medical or neurological problem?
No, I haven't started any new medications or used any drugs. I also don't have any medical or neurological issues that I know of before these symptoms began.
Have you ever had tics, like repeated blinking, facial movements, throat clearing, or other sudden movements or sounds you couldn’t control?
No, I have never experienced tics, sudden uncontrolled movements, or repetitive sounds. Those aren't things I've ever had to deal with.
Have these fears or rituals made you avoid places, people, or activities, or caused problems getting to work, school, or leaving the house on time?
To be honest, I haven't really thought about it that way. I'm not entirely sure if it has caused major avoidance or any significant delays in my daily routine.
On a typical day, do the checking and cleaning rituals take more than an hour total, even if you have to estimate?

Yes, they definitely take up much more than an hour every single day. Between washing my hands repeatedly and constantly going back to check the door locks and appliances, it makes it very hard to get through my day quickly. It easily adds up to several hours of my time.
